messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — StellarHealth wants a controlled pilot for the Optimize toolkit: per-route quant fallback, adaptive batching presets, prefix/KV caching, and eval-triggered alerts. Tight GA gates.

jordan: what are their perf/quality targets?

mira: p95 <= 120ms for short chat flows; <= 3% task accuracy drop on their health eval set; alert when concordance drops >5 pts over a 1k window.

andrew: hosted can hit that with conservative batching (batch <= 4) + strong cache hit rates. Dedicated easier. Plan: quant by default, fallback to FP16 on eval regression. Need hysteresis to avoid flapping.

sasha: propose hysteresis = 2 consecutive windows before auto-fallback. Also expose a route flag: quant_fallback: on|off|auto (auto = try quant, fallback on regression).

jordan: config sketch for pilot:
```yaml
route: /stella/chat
quant_profile: r4-24q
quant_fallback: auto
batching: preset: mobile_small
cache: prefix: enabled, size_mb: 512
eval_alerts: threshold_pts: 5, window: 1000, webhook: https://hooks.stellar/alerts
```

mira: draft acceptance criteria: p95 <= 120ms on 90% of pilot routes (24h windows); accuracy drop <= 3% vs FP16 baseline; eval webhook delivered within 5m of window close; token-level cost visible in console.

andrew: timeline: 2-week sprint to land flags + basic alerting + demo, then 1-week pilot run. If pilot shows kernel/compile needs, schedule next sprint.

sasha: ops notes: default per-tenant KV cache quota 5GB with LRU eviction; increases require infra/sales review. Watch for cache warm-up impact on early latency.

mira: mitigations: hysteresis, warm-up guidance in onboarding, simple cost simulator in console for pilot routes.

andrew: actions: @jordan write SDK/route-flag spec and tiny e2e test; @sasha post cache quota + eviction proposal; @mira draft pilot acceptance sheet and runbook.

ops-bot: Created ticket TID-7782: "optimize-pilot/stellarhealth" — assignees: mira, jordan, sasha, andrew.

mira: thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 10am to review PRs and pilot tracker. :thumbsup:
